# Pondy Boating - Mangrove Bay (Full Knowledge Base)

> Complete Guide to Boat Rides, Mangrove Safaris & Pricing in Pondicherry, India.

## About Pondy Boating (Mangrove Bay)
Pondy Boating (Mangrove Bay) operates daily from 7:00 AM to 5:30 PM, departing from Marina, Vambakeerapalayam, Puducherry 605001. Every boat ride is a full 1-hour (60-minute) journey exploring four iconic locations:
1. Mangrove Forest & Root Tunnels (protected tidal bio-reserve with exotic bird watching)
2. Historic 2,000-Year Arikamedu Indo-Roman Archaeological Port Ruins
3. Beach & River Confluence (where backwater lagoon meets the Bay of Bengal ocean waves)
4. Puducherry Fishing Harbour & Catamarans

## Pricing & Packages (1 Hour Full Duration)
- Shared Boating Ride: ₹500 per Adult, ₹250 per Child (ages 3–10; under 3 ride free).
- Couples Private Boat: ₹3,000 Flat Rate (100% private boat exclusively for 2 guests).
- Separate Private Vessel: ₹5,000 Flat Rate (exclusive charter for family/friends, 1 to 10 guests).
- All tickets include government-certified life jackets and licensed boat captains.

## Boarding Jetty Facilities
- 100% Free Vehicle Parking (Cars & Two-Wheelers directly at the jetty).
- Clean hygienic restrooms and toilet facilities.
- Private dress changing rooms.
